2026-10-19.summary:
### World & Resources
- Coconut trees now spawn at 25% chance (was 100%) and have reduced network range; apple and beehive spawn chances on oak trees increased to 25% (from 15%).

### Monuments
- All lighthouses now share a single repair progress bar, so repairing one contributes to all.

### UI Improvements
- Fixed gamepad inventory UI overlapping panels on certain resolutions, improving visibility of items.
- Added a separate "currently craftable" list and an "All" button in the cooking UI, making it easier to see what you can craft.
- Inventory category buttons now act as toggles, showing only the selected category; an "All" button returns to full view.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Helicopter rumble now only triggers when the helicopter is active, eliminating false rumble cues.
- Minigun bullets now correctly render when hitting surfaces within close range, fixing visual clipping near the player’s view.
